D: A suburban dad in a midlife crisis quits his job, buys his dream car and takes a job at a burger drive-thru.
P: Serve the burgers when Carolyn and Buddy pull up at the drive-thru.
S: Asparagus spears in a light tempura batter, salted while hot.

Stir the mayonnaise with the lemon zest and a squeeze of juice. Whisk the flour, cornflour, a pinch of salt and the soda water into a lumpy batter. Dip the spears and fry in oil at 180C in batches until pale gold and crisp. Salt and serve straight away with the lemon mayo.
Battered onion rings with a tangy pink dipping sauce.

Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, sriracha and relish into Smiley sauce. Whisk the flour, paprika, salt and lager into a smooth batter. Dust the rings in a little flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C in batches until golden. Drain, salt and serve with the sauce.
2 large brown onions, cut in thick rings@Produce
M: Cheeseburgers off the grill with pickles and fries, the job with the least possible responsibility.

Bake the chips at 220C until crisp. Shape the mince into 4 thin patties and season well. Griddle the patties in a very hot pan, flip, add the cheese and cover to melt. Toast the buns, spread with mayo and sauce and build with lettuce, tomato, pickles and the patties.
Real estate King popcorn shrimp baskets
Popcorn shrimp with slaw and horseradish sauce. The real estate King orders at the window.

Stir the tomato sauce and horseradish with a squeeze of lemon, and toss the cabbage with the mayo. Coat the prawns in seasoned flour, egg, then panko mixed with the Old Bay. Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and pink inside. Pile into paper-lined baskets with the slaw, sauce and lemon.
W: Vanilla soft-serve swirled with raspberry and rosewater, petals scattered on top.
Simmer the raspberries and sugar until jammy, then stir in the rosewater and cool. Scoop the ice cream into tall cups. Spoon over the sauce and scatter with rose petals and pistachios.
K: Cherry ice cream milkshakes blended thick.
Blend the ice cream, milk, frozen cherries and syrup until thick. Pour into chilled glasses and top each with a cherry.
